contexts.text: A life of faith without love is like light... without heat, as in winter, when nothing grows. AC 365:end. AC 1577:2. AC 2231:3. AC 3146:end. AC 4180:3, Described. AC 4416. AC 4802:3. AC 5194:2. AC 5232:2. AC 5482:end. AC 6405. AC 7084. AC 8301:2. HH 136:2. HH 482. NJHD 114. DLife 86:3. AR 875:4. TCR 385:3. SE 4924:2.

No faith, and faith without love, are compared by the Lord to winter in... Pray that your flight be not in the winter; for those shall be days of affliction ()... The winter = a life of no love, ( = removal from these things in a state of too much cold (that is) of aversion to love... AC 3755:2.)
Under Summer, see this reference. AC 935:2. DLW 102. AE 1146:3.
Then the Church arrives at its winter, or night. (See DLW 73:end.)
That light is like the wintry light. AC 5128:3. AC 5219:2. DLW 139:end. DP 168:4. SE 4213:end.
Where the year is so short (as in the Sixth Earth) the cold does not abide in winter... so that the ground is in continuous spring.
With an Angel... night and winter are turned into the idea of a state such as there is in Hell.
Wintry light, which is as bright as summer light, does not open anything... DP 297:2.
The light with man that corresponds to that of winter, is wisdom without its love.
Therefore men can be deliciated in marriage even in mid-winter. CL 222:4.
They abominate conjugial love and the whole female sex, consequently all the derivative loves, so that their life is at last a life of winter, and in fact a filthy one.
Thus they are devoid of love, and are wintry ones. They were antediluvians.
Thus the life (of the so-called Christian world) is like that of the antediluvian world, namely, a life of winter.
A life contrary to charity is as winter is to spring in the frigid zones; these are not regenerated, but only those with whom winter is as to spring in the temperate zones. Explained.
(In the Ultimate Heaven) they know, from certain signs, that their winter, spring, etc. are coming.
Before this, it is the time of winter with man.
Night and winter do not contribute to the stability of the world.
